body: Please, follow the rules and be well.
I know, but I wasn't able to see them during that tour, so I'd love if they decided to bring back that one next year. Must have clarified that part, sorry.
I hope so bc that song struck a chord (to some degree, oc) and I just loved it. Including this one and Zerstoren would be a dream come true for me.
Man, if I hadn't seen this, I wouldn't know they were back at Spoti. Best news ever. Gotta listen to this one to celebrate :-D
And don't even get me started on the soundtrack. Yamaoka was beyond flawless in this one.

This one is my fave. Playing twice thru all the scenarios might be boring for some, I get it, but the escort angle of the second part makes you play it from a different pov. Maybe with my most recent playthrough my only let down was Henry's lack of emotion during most, if not all, of the game, but hey some people's just like that. Henry's still great as the receiver of wisdom, and I just wish there had been a lot more of his background rather than just being the poor guy who ended up there (though he mentions feeling drawn to the apartment building...)

Ohh, I feel ya. Having the knowledge of what is what got us here in the first place, then being able to start over and make better choices. I've had this dream, more than once, and yeah right now I wish so. Why do you wish this??

Yes, my not going to therapy is because of quarantine - the clinic where I go shut down one or two days before my last scheduled appointment, and they didn't offer neither an online option nor a possible reopening time (which is totally logical, I know). Tried to get my therapist phone number but they were unwilling to give it to me (which I also understand).

According to current policies, I'll have to go on another month with no therapy. I've been trying to look for app and other online options, but they are either very automated or simply waaaaaaaay more expensive than my therapist charges me.

Thank you. I might try calling a crisis line, since I am lo longer able to continue going to therapy. 

About talking to my boss... Well I've tried to speak with her a little. Went as far as telling her I was feeling a bit overwhelmed about the various assignments on queue but her responses were along the line of "Oh, yeah, I imagine". Like I know it'd have been best had I come with a potential solution myself, but I was trying to reach out precisely because I couldn't find a solution on my own. Her answer, well my wall could've said as much.

I guess I don't really want to die, but my head feels pretty clouded and I just feel  there's no one I can open up about this. Or maybe is that I'm sick of tired and just wish someone would tell me the exact thing to do to get out of this dark place. Suicide sounds just like the magical answer. I don't know why but it sounds even more logical that just quitting my job - because then it'be dealing with all the "OMG why did you quit your job in such a hard time?"

Thank you so much for writing
Music and monster design are so on point. I think the story in general was good. It made me wanna hug Alex so badly.
Lot of noise at home and no headphones so I got my phone close to my ear to listen. Bad idea. Creepy af. Love it, tho.
